name: tiny-fish
description: A playful on-off switch whose thumb is a tiny fish that swims across a token-colored current.
purpose: Toggles a binary setting with a memorable motion cue when a quiet switch would disappear on a playful surface.
bestFor: settings with a light or playful voice
feature flags on demo and catalogue pages
avoidFor: dense toolbars that need a quiet control
forms that must match a standard switch exactly
